Name: [CORE] Renderer ganda (compact vs JsonResponse)
Description:
Scope: Dua jalur render: DRF compact dan JsonResponse ber-spasi untuk health/404/413.

Out of scope: perubahan kontrak API, refactor FE, unit/service test baru.

Bukti: laporan wire-parity/state-parity, link PR, checklist Definition of Done di kartu ini.

## Bukti (Fase 0, tanpa Docker)

Oracle: Django 5.2.17 + DRF 3.18.3 dari `apps/api/pyproject.toml`, dijalankan di venv lokal. Rekaman: `py contracts/tools/capture_errors.py` -> `contracts/golden/error-*` (11 case, `body.raw` byte-exact + `body.json` untuk review). Verifikasi: `cargo test --test error_golden` (3 test, 11 case).

Byte terukur (persis):
- 401 `{"detail":"Authentication credentials were not provided."}`
- 403 `{"detail":"You do not have permission to perform this action."}`
- 404 DRF `{"detail":"Not found."}`
- 404 Django `{"error": "Page not found."}`
- 405 `{"detail":"Method \"DELETE\" not allowed."}`
- 400 field `{"name":["This field is required."]}`
- 400 serializer `{"non_field_errors":["Something went wrong."]}`
- 400 view `["Something went wrong."]`
- 415 `{"detail":"Unsupported media type \"text/plain\" in request."}`
- 429 `{"error_code":5900,"error_message":"RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED"}`
- 413 `{"error": "REQUEST_BODY_TOO_LARGE", "detail": "The size of the request body exceeds the maximum allowed size."}`

Dua koreksi dari oracle:
1. DRF menyetel `Allow` di **semua** respons (`APIView.default_response_headers`), bukan hanya 405. 401/403/404/415/429 ikut membawa `Allow`, nilainya per view.
2. 413 dipicu `DATA_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE`; `settings/common.py` menyambungkannya dari env `FILE_SIZE_LIMIT` (default 5 MiB). Middleware membaca `DATA_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE`, bukan `FILE_SIZE_LIMIT`.

`Content-Type: application/json` tanpa charset di semua case (DRF `JSONRenderer.charset = None`).

Perintah verifikasi: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --all-targets` (20 test hijau), `route_parity.py --allow-missing` hijau.

### Temuan tambahan (REA, oracle Django/DRF)

- `JsonResponse` Django memakai `ensure_ascii=True`: `"Ren\u00e9"`, `"\ud83d\ude00"` (surrogate pair untuk astral), bukan UTF-8 mentah. DRF `JSONRenderer` mengirim UTF-8 mentah. `plane_pkg::json::spaced_json` sekarang meng-escape non-ASCII; `compact_json` tidak.
- Bukti: `contracts/golden/unicode-drf` (HTTP nyata) + unit test `json::tests::django_escapes_non_ascii_but_drf_keeps_utf8` dan `django_uses_surrogate_pairs_for_astral_characters`.
- `ErrorBody::ok(status, value)` ditambahkan supaya body sukses DRF melewati renderer yang sama; tidak ada jalur kedua.

Verifikasi akhir: `cargo fmt --all -- --check` 0, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` 0, `cargo test --all-targets` 23 test hijau, `route_parity.py --allow-missing` hijau, `capture_errors.py` 12 case.
